description: hydroscoper is an rOpenSci R interface to Hydroscope, the Greek National Data Bank for Hydrological and Meteorological Information. It retrieves station metadata and time-series values into tidy tables. It also converts coordinate representations and translates or transliterates Greek labels for subsequent analysis. The package includes station and time-series indexes, with actual observation periods determined by each Greek provider. A modeller can use it to assemble precipitation or flow inputs for catchment, water-supply and flood simulations. Code and usage examples are available through GitHub and CRAN under MIT. The underlying observations come from external public services and retain their own conditions. A limitation is that current data completeness and service availability must be checked for the requested station; the software does not supply a uniform national forcing series. No directly related catalogue record was established. This review read repository and package metadata without retrieving observations or testing the live data functions. The code is available free of charge under its stated licence.
